entities.name: Ugin
entities.description: An ancient dragon planeswalker who directed the imprisonment of the Eldrazi on Zendikar and is rebuilding the Eye of Ugin.

entities.name: Nahiri
entities.description: A planeswalker native to Zendikar who built the hedron network and kept watch over the Eldrazi prison, then disappeared searching for her allies.

entities.name: Sorin Markov
entities.description: An ancient planeswalker who helped imprison the Eldrazi and later returned to Zendikar with Nissa to seal the Eye.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: An elder dragon planeswalker who arranged for three planeswalkers to converge on the Eye and reactivate it.

entities.name: Sarkhan Vol
entities.description: A planeswalker described as Bolas's mad minion, one of three who activated the Eye.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A mind mage planeswalker and Living Guildpact who helps Gideon, learns hedron secrets from Ugin and helps trap Ulamog.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A pyromancer planeswalker who helped activate the Eye and later left her post as abbot of Keral Keep to return to Zendikar.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: A Joraga elf planeswalker who broke the last bonds of the Eldrazi, later restored her connection to Zendikar through the Khalni Heart and helps trap Ulamog.

entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: A planeswalker who recruits allies and leads the Zendikari army at Sea Gate.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A planeswalker whose help Gideon could not secure.

entities.name: Ob Nixilis
entities.description: A demon and former planeswalker who sought the Khalni Heart to reignite his spark and does so at Sea Gate, calling Kozilek.

entities.name: Jori En
entities.description: A merfolk scholar of Sea Gate who guides Jace to the Eye and warns Gideon about Ulamog.

entities.name: Kiora
entities.description: A merfolk planeswalker native to Zendikar who brings a weapon stolen from a god of Theros and sea monsters to the battle for Sea Gate.

entities.name: Drana
entities.description: The leader of a legion of vampires in Gideon's army.

entities.name: Noyan Dar
entities.description: The leader of the roilmages in Gideon's army.

entities.name: Tazri
entities.description: The leader of ground troops in Gideon's army.

entities.name: Ulamog
entities.description: An Eldrazi titan trapped in a hedron ring at Sea Gate until Ob Nixilis frees it.

entities.name: Emrakul
entities.description: One of the three Eldrazi titans imprisoned on Zendikar.

entities.name: Kozilek
entities.description: An Eldrazi titan called from beneath Zendikar by Ob Nixilis.

entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: Monstrous beings of the spaces between worlds that devour the mana and life of planes.

entities.name: Zendikari
entities.description: The people of Zendikar who fight to reclaim their world.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: A once tranquil mana-rich plane where the Eldrazi were imprisoned and have now been freed.

entities.name: Regatha
entities.description: The plane of Keral Keep where Chandra is abbot.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The city-world and center of planeswalker activity where Gideon recruits Jace.

entities.name: Theros
entities.description: The plane from which Kiora stole a god's weapon.

entities.name: Eye of Ugin
entities.description: The underground chamber at the center of the hedron network whose magic held the Eldrazi.

entities.name: Sea Gate
entities.description: The city on Tazeem that is overrun, retaken by Zendikari and made the site of the trap for Ulamog.

entities.name: Tazeem
entities.description: The continent where Sea Gate lies.

entities.name: Bala Ged
entities.description: A devastated continent of Zendikar where Nissa finds the Khalni Heart.

entities.name: Keral Keep
entities.description: The monastery on Regatha where Chandra was abbot.

entities.name: Khalni Heart
entities.description: An outgrowth of Zendikar's soul that Nissa uses to restore her connection to the plane.

entities.name: Hedron network
entities.description: The network of stone structures built by Nahiri to form the bars of a worldwide prison, and later used to trap Ulamog.

events.summary: Ugin, Nahiri and Sorin imprison the Eldrazi titans on Zendikar using a network of hedrons built by Nahiri.
A little over a thousand years ago the Eldrazi nearly escape and Nahiri restores their prison alone, then goes to check on her absent allies and is not seen again.
events.quote: Nahiri restored the Eldrazi's prison on her own

events.summary: Nicol Bolas arranges for Sarkhan Vol, Jace and Chandra to converge on the Eye and unknowingly reactivate it.
events.quote: the elder dragon Planeswalker Nicol Bolas arranged for three Planeswalkers to converge on the Eye and unknowingly reactivate it.

events.summary: Sorin returns with Nissa to seal the Eye, but Nissa breaks the last bonds and the Eldrazi titans emerge.
events.quote: she broke the last bonds holding them in, and the titans emerged into the world.

events.summary: Gideon arrives on Zendikar, defends the Zendikari, faces a titan and leaves to seek reinforcements on Ravnica.
events.quote: Vowing to return, he left in search of aid at the center of Planeswalker activity: the city-world of Ravnica.

events.summary: Gideon recruits Jace on Ravnica but not Liliana or Chandra, and the two return to Zendikar.
events.quote: Together, Gideon and Jace returned to Zendikar to face the threat of the Eldrazi.

events.summary: Gideon and Jace find Sea Gate overrun and hold off the Eldrazi so survivors can flee.
events.quote: the two were able to hold off the Eldrazi to allow survivors to flee to safety.

events.summary: Nissa loses her connection to Zendikar's soul and agrees to meet the others outside Sea Gate.
events.quote: But her connection to Zendikar's elemental soul had suddenly vanished

events.summary: Nissa finds the Khalni Heart in Bala Ged, restores her connection to Zendikar and defeats Ob Nixilis.
events.quote: Nissa bested Ob Nixilis , removed the Khalni Heart to safety, and left the demon seething underground.

events.summary: Jace, guided by Jori En, meets Ugin at the Eye, learns how hedrons can imprison the Eldrazi and decides to ignore Ugin's warnings.
events.quote: Ignoring Ugin's dire warnings, Jace left the Eye and made his way to Sea Gate

events.summary: Gideon gathers Drana, Noyan Dar, Tazri, Nissa and Kiora's forces and retakes Sea Gate from the Eldrazi.
events.quote: Together, their combined forces managed to wrest Sea Gate away from the Eldrazi invaders.

events.summary: Jori En returns with the news that Ulamog is headed toward Sea Gate.
events.quote: the Eldrazi titan Ulamog himself was headed towards Sea Gate.

events.summary: Gideon, Jace and Nissa trap Ulamog in a ring of hedrons at Sea Gate.
events.quote: Gideon lured the titan into the center of the ring while the other two activated the network, imprisoning Ulamog.

events.summary: Ob Nixilis arrives and knocks the hedrons out of alignment to siphon their energy and reignite his spark.
events.quote: Ob Nixilis knocked the hedrons out of alignment to siphon their energy and reignite his Planeswalker spark.

events.summary: Chandra leaves Keral Keep for Zendikar and finds Ob Nixilis disrupting the hedron network.
events.quote: she left the Keep for Zendikar...only to find Ob Nixilis disrupting the hedron network.

events.summary: Gideon attacks the trapped Ulamog, but Ob Nixilis calls Kozilek from beneath Zendikar, leaving two titans rampaging.
events.quote: Ob Nixilis had called Kozilek, one of the other Eldrazi titans, from beneath Zendikar's surface.

relations.note: Nahiri constructed the hedron network at Ugin's direction.
relations.quote: At Ugin's direction, Nahiri constructed a massive network of stone structures called hedrons
his own mad minion Sarkhan Vol

relations.note: Sorin and Ugin, with Nahiri, acted together to imprison the Eldrazi.
relations.quote: Three ancient Planeswalkers—Ugin, the Spirit Dragon; Nahiri, the Lithomancer; and Sorin Markov—took action to stop those first Eldrazi.

relations.note: Nissa freed the titans from their last bonds hoping they would leave Zendikar.
relations.quote: she broke the last bonds holding them in

relations.note: Nissa defeated Ob Nixilis and took the Khalni Heart.
Gideon gathers and leads the allied survivors.
relations.quote: Gideon gathered an allied group of the Zendikari survivors.

relations.note: Ob Nixilis called Kozilek from beneath Zendikar.
